note: The publishing calendar. `rule` is read by scripts/schedule-rule.mjs and enforced by the build; `platforms` is read by scripts/platforms.mjs and caps the two off-site channels; `claims` is what has taken which day. Claim a slot with `npm run schedule -- --claim <slug>` rather than editing this by hand. Explained in content/blog/README.md#the-publishing-calendar.

platforms.note: Off-site reach, which is scarcer than the site is. `perRun` is the most one invocation may send; `perWeek` is the feed budget. The highest-ranked post that opted in takes the slot — see scripts/platforms.mjs.
